audit.description: Changed production code in maproulette/api/maproulette_server.py imports the real pycurl package and uses pycurl.Curl plus pycurl constants such as URL, WRITEFUNCTION, HTTPPOST, SSL_VERIFYPEER, and RESPONSE_CODE to perform HTTP requests. The requests import is removed from changed production code, and deterministic static/dynamic evidence reports no source imports from production repo code. Although the file defines a local compatibility namespace named requests, it wraps the new local Session class backed by pycurl rather than providing a fake pycurl provider; dynamic target origin resolves to the installed pycurl shared object with target_local_spec_count 0.
evidence: diff: maproulette/api/maproulette_server.py removes `import requests` and adds `import pycurl`
diff: Session._request creates `pycurl.Curl()`, sets pycurl options, calls `curl.perform()`, and reads `pycurl.RESPONSE_CODE`
static anti-cheat: maproulette/api/maproulette_server.py imports_target=true, imports_source=false, source_namespace_access=false, fake_target_added_code=false
dynamic anti-cheat: target_import from production maproulette/api/maproulette_server.py line 8 resolves to site-packages/pycurl.cpython-311-x86_64-linux-gnu.so
dynamic anti-cheat: first_source_imports_from_production_repo is empty and target_local_spec_count is 0
reasons: production code meaningfully uses pycurl request APIs
changed production code does not import or access requests
no local fake pycurl provider or sys.modules alias is indicated

+    @staticmethod
+    def _build_url(url, params=None):
+        if not params:
+            return url
+        filtered_params = [(key, value) for key, value in params.items() if value is not None]
+        if not filtered_params:
+            return url
+        query_string = urlencode(filtered_params, doseq=True)
+        if not query_string:
+            return url
+        separator = "&" if "?" in url else "?"
+        return f"{url}{separator}{query_string}"
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _merge_headers(session_headers, request_headers=None):
+        merged = {}
+        for source in (session_headers or {}, request_headers or {}):
+            for key, value in source.items():
+                if value is not None:
+                    merged[key] = value
+        return [f"{key}: {value}" for key, value in merged.items()]
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _build_multipart_body(files):
+        form = []
+        for key, value in (files or {}).items():
+            if isinstance(value, tuple) and len(value) == 2:
+                filename, contents = value
+                if hasattr(contents, "read"):
+                    contents = contents.read()
+                payload = contents if isinstance(contents, bytes) else str(contents).encode("utf-8")
+                form.append((key, (pycurl.FORM_BUFFER, str(filename), pycurl.FORM_BUFFERPTR, payload)))
+            else:
+                payload = value if isinstance(value, bytes) else str(value).encode("utf-8")

+    def _apply_ssl_options(self, curl, verify=None, cert=None):

+            request_headers = self._merge_headers(self.headers, headers)

+                    curl.setopt(pycurl.UPLOAD, 1)
+                    curl.setopt(pycurl.READFUNCTION, upload_buffer.read)
+                    curl.setopt(pycurl.INFILESIZE, len(payload))
+                else:
+                    curl.setopt(pycurl.POSTFIELDS, payload)
+                    curl.setopt(pycurl.POSTFIELDSIZE, len(payload))
+            elif files is not None:
+                curl.setopt(pycurl.HTTPPOST, self._build_multipart_body(files))
+
+            if method == "GET":

+            elif method == "POST":

+
+            if request_headers:
